result.title: Recurrent Point Transformer via Test-Time Training
result.summary: Real-world point clouds are not naturally bounded: 3D scans grow as sensors move through rooms, LiDAR surveys extend across forest plots, and 4D captures can span thousands of frames. Yet most point-cloud encoders are designed for fixed-size inputs, forcing inference-time cropping or tiling that loses long-range context and requires ad-hoc output stitching. We formulate arbitrary-extent point-cloud segmentation as recurrent sequence-of-chunks processing and introduce PoinTTT, a recurrent point-cloud encoder built on Point Transformer V3 (PTv3). PoinTTT augments PTv3 with residual Large Chunk Test-Time Training (LaCT) layers in both the encoder and decoder. Each LaCT layer maintains compact fast weights as recurrent state: tokens from each chunk update the fast weights, which are then applied to produce chunk features and passed to the next chunk. This design allows PoinTTT to train on fixed-size chunks while processing scenes of arbitrary spatial or temporal extent, with activation memory bounded by the chunk size. A pilot study on ScanNet and nuScenes shows that recurrent TTT improves segmentation over PTv3 baselines. On FOR-instanceV2, PoinTTT achieves state-of-the-art forest semantic segmentation of 87.9 mIoU with nearly constant memory. On HOI4D, online full-sequence recurrent inference carries state across clips rather than resetting at benchmark boundaries, reaching 42.6 mIoU; a matched full-sequence Mamba control reaches approximately 39.9. These results suggest that test-time training is a practical primitive for scalable spatial and temporal point-cloud understanding.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PoinTTT：在 Point Transformer V3 编解码器中加入残差式大块测试时训练（LaCT）层，用每个 chunk 的 token 更新紧凑的 fast weights 作为循环状态，从而在固定尺寸块上训练、处理任意空间或时间范围的点云分割，并把激活显存限制在块大小内。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接关系，但其「以 fast weights 作为跨块循环状态、按输入流更新」的做法，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态如何更新、训练与推理状态不一致以及长度泛化的问题。
